primary: actual generated tokens divided by the wall seconds of the 8-request HTTP cohort
order_rule: Alternate cohorts by block. Reverse arm order for cpu25. Alternate which condition goes first by block.
visit_rule: Fresh server for each arm. Each cohort has one warmup, one measured request; model loading and warmup are excluded. Eight-prompt fixture precedes single-short.
power: AC online at visit endpoints and each warmup and measured HTTP boundary
audit: Same model, binaries, runtime settings, payloads and token IDs for all arms in each block. Require actual kernel registration, selected-task masks, receiver and detach for each SCX visit. Save and report all failures. No replacing slow observations.
phase_metrics: Per visit, sum of per-request phase tokens divided by sum of per-request phase seconds. Simultaneous requests can overlap.

uncertainty.method: percentile bootstrap of paired block gains, stratified by cohort

scope: One AMD measurement campaign, no promotion or independent-confirmation claim
